about: P57 T8: the 50 most-used library models pushed to 8+. Targets: every gen3d model in the top 50 (even at 8+), CC0 and originals only below 8. Per round 4 candidates (image prompt a/b x 2 seeds) by ops/gen3d with the hero finishing profile, each scaled into the old box; Opus 5.5 picks the best on a 2x2 grid, the pick is scored blind on 3x3 grids (old models Opus did not score in T4 rejudged on the same grids). A round wins at >= 8 and above the old score; round 2 only for ids without a winner, with the first round judge reason turned into the prompt fix. Winners swapped in by promote-batch replaceModels (profile hero: LOD0 up to 8000 triangles, LOD1 at most the old LOD1).

t8r: From 22 Oct (T8r, batches 4-5 and a re-duel of batches 1-3): prompts a, b, c, c with the old box proportions in the prompt; a round wins when its pick scores >= 6 AND beats the current model in a blind pair duel (one sheet, order drawn by pure-rand) with both judges - Opus and Codex within the daily cap, else Opus twice with the order swapped. 8+ stays the measured goal in summary, not the swap rule.

cc0Veg.about: P57 T8r item 4 (owner decision 22 Oct): vegetation the 3D generator draws badly, taken from CC0 packs already on disk instead. Targets: vegetation among the top-50 targets not yet replaced, plus kit-missing vegetation the catalog has below 6. Candidates by file name from packs whose CC0-1.0 licence is declared in scripts/assets/cc0/sources.json and stated in the licence text shipped in the pack; styled like the other CC0 catalog models, fitted into the old box (scripts/p57/regen.mjs fit) and checked against the replace rules (bounds +-10 %, LOD1 at most the old one). Opus 5.5 scores them blind 1-10 on 3x3 grids; the best at >= 6 duels the current model blind (scripts/p57/duel.mjs). replaced = won both duel votes and swapped in by promote-batch replaceModels (origin cc0, profile hero). No CC0 match = the id stays with the generator.
